title: Q3 Brand Awareness Campaign
description: Design and launch a multi-channel brand awareness campaign targeting millennials in urban markets. Include social media, podcast sponsorships, and experiential pop-up events in 5 major cities.
project_plan: Conduct market research and audience segmentation for millennial urban demographics
Develop creative brief and brand messaging framework across all channels
Secure podcast sponsorship deals with 3-5 top-performing shows in target demo
Plan and coordinate pop-up experience events in NYC, LA, Chicago, Austin, and Miami
Build social media content calendar with platform-specific assets for Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter
Set up attribution tracking and KPI dashboards to measure campaign ROI
notes: Budget approved. Creative agency onboarded last week.

title: Customer Onboarding Revamp
description: Redesign the customer onboarding flow to reduce time-to-value and improve 30-day retention. Current onboarding has a 40% drop-off rate at step 3.
project_plan: Analyze current onboarding funnel data and identify top drop-off points with user session recordings
Conduct 10 customer interviews to understand friction points and unmet expectations
Design 3 alternative onboarding flow prototypes with progressive disclosure approach
Run A/B tests on new flows with 20% of new signups over 4 weeks
Implement winning variant and add in-app tooltips for complex features

title: Annual Employee Engagement Survey
description: Run the annual employee engagement survey, analyze results, and create action plans for each department. Last year's response rate was 72% — goal is 85%+.
project_plan: Revise survey questions based on last year's feedback and add new DEI section
Partner with department heads to champion survey participation and hit 85% response rate
Analyze results by department, tenure, and role level to surface actionable themes
Present executive summary to leadership with top 5 company-wide action items
Facilitate department-level workshops to co-create improvement plans with teams
notes: Achieved 89% response rate! Results shared with leadership on March 1.

title: Competitor Pricing Analysis
description: Deep dive into competitor pricing models, packaging, and positioning. We're losing deals on price — need to understand if we have a pricing problem or a packaging problem.
project_plan: Identify top 8 competitors and document their current pricing tiers, features, and positioning
Interview 5 recently lost deals to understand price sensitivity vs. perceived value gap
Map feature-to-price ratios across competitors to find our positioning white space
Model 3 alternative pricing/packaging scenarios with revenue impact projections
Present recommendations to leadership with go/no-go decision framework

title: Podcast Launch Strategy
description: Launch a company podcast featuring conversations with industry leaders about the future of work. Goal is thought leadership and top-of-funnel awareness.
project_plan: Define podcast format, episode length, and release cadence (weekly vs. biweekly)
Create guest wishlist of 20 industry leaders and begin outreach with personalized pitches
Set up recording equipment and post-production workflow with intro/outro branding
Record and produce 3 pilot episodes before public launch for quality benchmarking
Develop distribution strategy across Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, and social clips
Build measurement framework tracking downloads, listener retention, and lead attribution
notes: Paused until Q2 — waiting on executive sponsor approval.
